input: Yao et al. (2023) manually labeled 200 HotpotQA trajectories from ReAct and CoT. CoT fails mostly through hallucination, while ReAct's failures include reasoning errors such as repetitive steps and non-informative search results that derail reasoning; the best prompting results combine ReAct with CoT-SC. Critique a claim that ReAct removes hallucination and is strictly better than chain-of-thought.
source: Yao et al. 2023, Section 3.3 Results and Observations (chunks yao2023-016 to yao2023-018)
